title: Cardioid-8C — Stereo Studio Monitor Pair Near Front Wall (SBIR Elimination)
description: Simulates a 60° equilateral stereo studio monitor pair placed 55 cm from the control-room front wall (y = -1.50 m), comparing an acoustic resistive-slot cardioid monitor against a conventional omnidirectional-bass monitor.
design_notes: The Studio SBIR Trap: At 55 cm front-wall offset, the rear-radiated bass wave bounces off the studio wall with a 1.1 m round-trip delay, creating a severe quarter-wave cancellation notch around 140–160 Hz at the mix chair.

Passive Acoustic Cardioid Slots: Flow-resistive side slots delay and invert the rear cone wave by 22 cm internal + exterior path, attenuating rear radiation toward the front wall by 10–14 dB across 90–350 Hz.
